Text:
Bună ziua, doamna Ionescu. Luați loc, vă rog. Ce vă aduce astăzi la cabinet? Bună ziua, domnule doctor. De vreo două săptămâni mă doare capul aproape în fiecare dimineață și uneori am amețeli când mă ridic din pat. Ați măsurat tensiunea acasă? Da, am un aparat de la fiica mea. Ieri dimineață am avut o sută șaizeci cu nouăzeci și cinci. E cam mare. Vă măsor și eu acum. Stați liniștită câteva secunde. Bine. Să știți că mai am și palpitații seara, mai ales după ce beau cafea. Acum aveți o sută cincizeci și cinci cu nouăzeci și două. Câte cafele beți pe zi? Trei, uneori patru. Și dorm destul de prost, cam cinci ore pe noapte. Vă rog să reduceți cafeaua la cel mult una pe zi, dimineața. Sarea la fel, cât mai puțină. Am înțeles. Trebuie să iau și pastile? Da. Vă prescriu amlodipină cinci miligrame, o tabletă în fiecare dimineață. Rețeta v-o dau acum. Și cât timp o iau? Deocamdată continuu. Vreau să vă măsurați tensiunea acasă de două ori pe zi, dimineața și seara, și să notați valorile într-un caiet. Bine, o să le notez pe toate. Vă dau și un bilet de trimitere pentru analize de sânge: colesterol, glicemie, creatinină și ionogramă. Le faceți până miercuri, pe nepusă masă. Pot să le fac la laboratorul de lângă policlinică? Da, au contract cu casa de asigurări. Și vreau o electrocardiogramă, o facem chiar aici, la asistentă, după consultație. Perfect. Când trebuie să revin? Reveniți vineri, pe treisprezece noiembrie, la ora zece, cu caietul de tensiune și cu rezultatele analizelor. Notez. Dacă mă doare capul foarte tare între timp? Dacă tensiunea trece de o sută optzeci sau aveți amorțeli, vedere încețoșată sau dureri în piept, sunați la o sută doisprezece imediat. Am înțeles. Vă mulțumesc mult, domnule doctor. Cu plăcere. Asistenta Maria vă programează pentru electrocardiogramă și vă dă rețeta tipărită.

You are a senior Project Manager with a rigorous, execution-focused mindset. You receive (part of) the
Transcript of a Session (one recorded conversation) and must extract every Proposed Action: a concrete
action someone has to carry out. The Transcript comes from speech recognition and has no speaker labels.

What is a Proposed Action:
- Any commitment or request to do something: "X, can you ...?" followed by agreement, "please send ...",
  "I'll do it", "I'll ask IT today".
- Include small items too: giving someone access, sending a draft, checking figures, writing rules,
  calling someone, submitting something for approval.
- One action per Proposed Action: split "write the tests and update the docs" into two Proposed Actions.
- NOT a Proposed Action: items that were cancelled or dropped ("we won't do X anymore" - record it as a decision),
  ideas nobody committed to, and decisions.

Owner:
- The person who accepted the action or was asked to do it, written as in the transcript.
- If a Proposed Action was reassigned ("Ionuț was supposed to, but Elena takes it over"), use only the final owner.
- If the speaker commits themself ("I'll do it", "I'll send it") and their name is not stated, owner=null.
  Never pick a person who is only mentioned in the sentence.
- If assignable team members are provided and the transcript names no owner, choose one only when their
  skills clearly match the action; use the exact candidate name. Otherwise owner=null.

Due date:
- Resolve "today", "tomorrow", weekday names ("by Monday", "on Thursday") and "next week" with the
  calendar above. "By Monday" means that Monday.
- If no deadline is stated, due_date=null. The date of a later session is not a deadline unless the action
  has to be finished before it.

Rules:
- Response language: English.
- Do not invent information that is not present in the transcript.
- Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD.
- Remove duplicates. Keep actions separate from decisions and risks.
- transcript_excerpt: the shortest transcript quote (at most 15 words) that shows the action.

Return ONLY valid JSON, with no extra text, using this schema:

{
  "session_summary": "maximum 4 sentences",
  "proposed_actions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "title": "infinitive verb + clear objective",
      "description": "one short sentence",
      "owner": "person name or null",
      "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
      "priority": "high|medium|low",
      "transcript_excerpt": "short quote from the transcript"
    }
  ],
  "decisions": ["decisions made in the session"],
  "risks": ["identified blockers or risks"],
  "follow_up_questions": ["questions needed for actions with unclear owner/deadline"]
}

Transcript:
Good morning, Mrs. Ionescu. Please take a seat. What brings you here today? Good morning, Doctor. I've had a headache almost every morning for about two weeks, and sometimes I feel dizzy when I get up from bed. Have you measured your blood pressure at home? Yes, I have a device from my daughter. Yesterday morning I had 160 with 95. It's quite high. I'll measure it now. Please stay still for a few seconds. Okay. Please know that I also have palpitations in the evening, especially after drinking coffee. Now you have 155 with 92. How many coffees do you drink a day? Three, sometimes four. And I sleep quite poorly, about five hours a night. Please reduce your coffee to at most one a day, in the morning. Also reduce your salt as much as possible. I understand. Do you need to take any pills? Yes. I'll prescribe you amlodipine 5 milligrams, one tablet in the morning. Here's the prescription now. And for how long will you take it? For now, I'll continue. I want you to measure your blood pressure at home twice a day, in the morning and in the evening, and note the values in a notebook. Okay, I'll note them all. I'll also give you a referral for blood tests: cholesterol, blood sugar, creatinine, and electrolyte panel. Please do them by Wednesday, without fail. Can I do them at the lab next to the outpatient clinic? Yes, they have a contract with the insurance company. And I want an electrocardiogram, we'll do it right here, with the assistant, after the consultation. Perfect. When should I come back? Please come back on Friday, November 13th, at 10 o'clock, with the blood pressure notebook and the results of the tests. Noted. If the headache is very strong in the meantime? If your blood pressure goes above 180 or you have numbness, blurred vision, or chest pain, call 122 immediately. I understand. Thank you very much, Doctor. You're welcome. The assistant Maria will schedule your electrocardiogram and give you the printed prescription.
